sources: https://secure.rec1.com/PA/bucks-county-pa-parks-recreation/catalog (Bucks County's rec1 catalog: Camping tab rules and fees; Lake Towhee Park's 19 campsites, each site's details and rate records)

values.note: Family campsites $25 a day per site for Bucks County residents, $50 for non-residents; group camping $5 / $10 a person a day. Card payments carry a $1.50 to 2.35% convenience fee; $10 cancellation fee.

fees.source: https://secure.rec1.com/PA/bucks-county-pa-parks-recreation/catalog (Camping tab, Fees & Payment: 'Family Campsites: $25/day per site' residents, '$50/day per site' non-residents; every Lake Towhee campsite's 'Resident Rate' $25 / 'Non-Resident Rate' $50, rate records dated 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31), read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: https://secure.rec1.com/PA/bucks-county-pa-parks-recreation/catalog (Camping tab: 'Our campsites are rustic with no electric or water hookups') + https://www.buckscounty.gov/facilities/facility/details/Lake-Towhee-Park-2 ('Campsites are rustic with no electric or water'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 17 family sites and 2 group sites; family sites 1, 3, 4, 5, 9, 11, 12, 15, 16 and 17 'will allow for an RV 25ft or less, a trailer 18ft or less, or two tents' (the rest are tent sites). One unit per site, 2 vehicles, up to 6 people. Sites 15-17 are in the main park.

sites.source: https://secure.rec1.com/PA/bucks-county-pa-parks-recreation/catalog (Lake Towhee site details, e.g. Campsite 01: 'Site #1 will allow for an RV 25ft or less, a trailer 18ft or less, or two tents'; Camping tab: 'Travel homes: max length 25 ft, trailers: max 18 ft, one unit per site') + https://www.buckscounty.gov/facilities/facility/details/Lake-Towhee-Park-2 ('17 family camp sites and 2 group camp sites'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Comfort station with water faucet and shower April 15 - November 15; primitive/portable toilets the rest of the year. Dump station for permitted campers only.

facilities.source: https://www.buckscounty.gov/facilities/facility/details/Lake-Towhee-Park-2 ('Comfort station with water faucet and shower is available April 15-November 15') + https://secure.rec1.com/PA/bucks-county-pa-parks-recreation/catalog (Camping tab: 'Comfort stations are closed Nov 15-Apr 15; primitive toilets remain open year-round', 'Dump stations are available at Tohickon Valley and Lake Towhee for permitted campers only'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Sites 15-17 in the main park: 'Camping is available year round'; the comfort station and shower close November 15 - April 15 (portable toilets then).

season.source: https://secure.rec1.com/PA/bucks-county-pa-parks-recreation/catalog (Lake Towhee Campsites 15-17: 'Camping is available year round ... Portable Toilets available off season November 15 - April 15'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Reserve through Bucks County's rec1 catalog (account needed) or call 215-757-0571. Rentals are accepted only for the current calendar year. Check-in after 3 pm, check-out before 2 pm; written cancellation 7 business days ahead.

booking.source: https://secure.rec1.com/PA/bucks-county-pa-parks-recreation/catalog (Camping tab: 'Rentals are accepted only for the current calendar year', 'Maximum stay: 14 consecutive days per visit', check-in/out, cancellation) + https://www.buckscounty.gov/facilities/facility/details/Lake-Towhee-Park-2 ('Reserve a Campsite'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed $25 resident / $50 non-resident, no electric or water, shower and dump, RVs to 25 ft, 14-day limit, online booking. Added 10 RV-capable sites (1, 3-5, 9, 11, 12, 15-17; trailers only to 18 ft), drinking water at the comfort station, year-round camping at sites 15-17 with the comfort station closed Nov 15 - Apr 15, county rec1 booking, current-calendar-year rule.
